title.narrative: Public perception of the effectiveness of the peace process

description.narrative: Public perception of the effectiveness of the peace process

comment.narrative: This indicator has been slightly revised to concretely fit the needs of the project. As such the indicator after revision now refers to the of negative views held by community members in regard to the effectiveness of the processes in place regarding natural resource management sharing with an indication that this perception indicator should decrease over time past project implementation. A new analysis of the Baseline data was conducted to be able to provide adjusted Baseline figures as well.

At the baseline 515 F 505 M 271 of the respondents reported negative views held by community members in regard to the effectiveness of the processes in place regarding natural resource management. While the endline 3975 F 416 M 265 of the respondents reported negative views held by community members in regard to the effectiveness of the processes in place regarding natural resource management. There is 12 decrease of the target respondents reporting negative views held by community members in regard to the effectiveness of the processes in place regarding natural resource management.
